A '''cordine patch''' was used to administer [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] directly into a patient. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Aurin Leith]] used a cordine patch on [[Gebnerret Vibrion]] during their escape from the [[Selnesh Imperial Detention Center]].
